levels.tier1Note: Just starting out; knows the rules and etiquette
levels.tier2Note: 1–3 years playing; entry level in a typical drop-in group
levels.tier3Note: 3–5 years playing; lower-mid in a typical drop-in group
levels.tier4Note: 5–10 years playing; mid level in a typical drop-in group
levels.tier5Note: 10+ years playing; upper-mid in a typical drop-in group
levels.tier6Note: Top school-team players, sports scholarship, amateur Division 1, etc.
levels.tier7Note: Division 1 players and national team athletes
levels.desc1: Just starting badminton; has learned the rules and match etiquette
levels.desc2: Can rally mid-height clears for 10 shots at mid-court; serves land over half the time
levels.desc3: From a set spot, about half of rallies reach the back two-thirds of the court; serves succeed 90%+
levels.desc4: Correct grip; from a set spot men clear to the back court and women to mid-back; can do basic drives; solid on both forehand and backhand
levels.desc5: Correct grip; some grasp of basic footwork; handles basic shots reliably when not under pressure
levels.desc6: Some grasp of footwork and rotation (not yet fluent); starting to smash and cut; clears on the move reach mid-back when not pressured
levels.desc7: Smash, cut, and clear—stationary or moving—land 70%+ with consistency; has basic defense but little variation
levels.desc8: Has basic tactics and timing; comfortable with basic rotation; cuts, smashes, clears, and net shots 70%+ accurate; slight variation in defense
levels.desc9: At least three of cut/smash/clear/net are 90%+ accurate and high quality; hits with power; defense has real variation and consistency
levels.desc10: Comfortable and adaptable with rotation; uses strategy and shot placement to score effectively
levels.desc11: Accurate on cut, smash, clear, and net; combines power, speed, and strategy; executes all backhand shots with ease; defense is threatening
levels.desc12: Fast movement and nimble footwork; smashes, cuts, and drops are fast and aggressive; often produces a one-hit winner
levels.desc13: All shots stable and polished; airtight defense, fast high-quality shots, excellent strategic organization and explosiveness
levels.desc14: All shots stable and polished; airtight defense, fast high-quality shots (school-team / sports-scholarship / amateur Division 1 level)
levels.desc15: All shots stable and polished; top amateur level
levels.desc16: Masterful shots, tactics, and footwork; has developed a distinctive personal style
levels.desc17: Professional level; Division 1 / national team athlete
